name: 꼬모 뒤 업힐·다운힐
about: 꼬모 뒤 업힐·다운힐 (11-15; user: "꼬모 업힐 다운힐도 내려와서는 우리 원래 코스랑 같고 업다운쪽에는 길이 지금보다 1.5배 쯤 넓어져야 할듯", "에프원 트랙처럼 아스팔트 멋있게 깔고 경계석 깔고 …", "너무 구불구불한건 없으면 좋음"): the hill route as before - up past Como to the hilltop, the ridge behind the Artist's Garden, down to the north-west inlet - on a 4 m grey asphalt road (its own ramp over the stairs), the line smoothed within 2.5 m of the path; the lakeside path shared with the lake loop as it was. Laid by tools/courses/road_follow.py from tools/courses/specs/hill.json.
